claims.statement: For the explicitly encoded heterogeneous trees with branch profiles (2,3,4) at p=7 and (2,2,4,3) at p=8, the exact weighted deletion-plus-exactly-two-neighbor-insertion network saturates all upper supply: respectively 1563/1563 and 8751/8751. Their full selected aggregates are respectively -1218 and -5434.
claims.scope: Only the two labeled trees, their computed eligible ranks, and the finite relation networks specified in the source report and EVIDENCE.json.
claims.reason: retained — the edge lists define the stated trees; replay confirms the independence vectors, first descents, strict eligibility guards, every original-leaf selector value, complete distinct-tag sums, and flow totals. A separate labeled-set checker verifies every emitted positive flow arc is a permitted deletion or exact-two-neighbor switch and checks endpoint ranks, capacities, and conservation. These exact checks support the finite claim only, not a universal theorem.

limitations: The evidence is bounded to the two listed trees and their finite networks; it proves no statement for other heterogeneous profiles or arbitrary ordinary trees.
The direct network computation does not audit or establish the separate homogeneous T_m orbit-lifting argument, which is not used by this claim.
The negative sums and saturated flows are not a refutation or proof of the primary universal aggregate.
